verdict.rationale: Multiple docs confirm natural-language generation/editing of agents and automations ('Describe what you want in chat, and Activepieces builds the agent or automation for you', 'Write summarise my unread emails every morning and you get a drafted agent', 'describe a change in the editor... and the instructions and tools are rewritten for you'), plus an MCP server enabling AI assistants to build/edit flows via NL. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of prompt-to-workflow generation quality and no third-party report confirming it works reliably in practice.
